rows.answer_text: Visakoivu Oy holds a valid LUSA qualification (LUSA-patevyys) for LVI and electrical contracting, currently valid until 2027-03-31, and will provide the certificate for verification on request.
Visakoivu Oy's turnover in the most recently closed financial year, 2025, was EUR 20,300,000, comfortably above the threshold set out in Section 3.2.

Visakoivu Oy encloses supporting certification and financial evidence for the eligibility requirements set out in Section 3 with this tender, and will provide further documentation for verification on request.

Visakoivu Oy will take handover of the existing asset register and associated documentation at the start of the contract, verifying its completeness against the property list in Appendix 2. The register will then be maintained as a live document within our NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system, updated after every maintenance visit and reviewed at scheduled intervals throughout the contract.

Visakoivu Oy proposes service level targets differentiated by priority category: faults affecting safety or continued operation of the building are attended as an emergency priority; faults causing material inconvenience but no immediate risk are treated as urgent; and planned, non-urgent work follows the agreed maintenance schedule. Specific response and completion time targets for each category will be set out in the SLA schedule agreed with Koskimyllyn Kiinteistot Oy at contract start.

Visakoivu Oy inspects the building envelope -- roofing, facades and windows -- as part of the annual maintenance cycle through a scheduled walk-down inspection carried out by qualified technicians, using a standard checklist covering weathertightness, visible damage and wear. Findings are logged, photographed where relevant, prioritised by severity, and reported to the client with recommended remedial action.

Following any equipment replacement or repair, Visakoivu Oy carries out functional commissioning and testing against a documented checklist appropriate to the equipment type, confirming correct operation, safety interlocks and integration with building automation where applicable. Commissioning results are recorded and signed off before the work is closed out, with documentation provided to the client.

Visakoivu Oy passes through the full manufacturer's warranty on all supplied equipment and replacement parts, and additionally warrants its own installation and repair workmanship; the specific workmanship warranty duration will be confirmed in the commercial offer and contract documents.
Visakoivu Oy proposes monthly invoicing, issued as a Finnish e-invoice (verkkolasku) itemised by property, in line with our standard billing practice for property maintenance contracts.
Visakoivu Oy proposes an initial contract period of three years, with an option for the client to extend by a further one plus one years; exact terms will be confirmed in the commercial offer.
Visakoivu Oy has completed the Tender Form set out in Appendix 1 and encloses it together with this technical and commercial proposal.
Pricing in this tender is quoted in EUR per square metre per year, as required, and not as a monthly rate.
Visakoivu Oy applies price per square metre, based on the property areas set out in Appendix 2, and this unit basis is applied consistently throughout the quotation.
This tender is submitted by e-mail to hankinnat@koskimyllynkiinteistot.example ahead of the submission deadline of 14 April 2026, 12:00 Helsinki time.

Visakoivu Oy encloses an occupational safety plan (tyoturvallisuussuunnitelma) covering work carried out on the properties, prepared under our NMSB 75310:2018 occupational health and safety management system.

Visakoivu Oy holds stock of commonly needed spare parts for the HVAC, electrical and building automation equipment types typically found in this type of portfolio, sourced through established supplier relationships. Delivery time for parts not held in stock depends on the manufacturer and part; further detail on availability for the specific equipment covered by this contract is provided in the technical proposal.

Visakoivu Oy encloses CVs of the key personnel proposed for this contract. Proposed staff are drawn from our teams of 62 LVI technicians, 48 electricians and 18 building automation specialists, with the specific individuals named in the enclosed CVs.

general_sections.cover_letter: Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this tender for technical property maintenance services for the portfolio managed by Koskimyllyn Kiinteistot Oy. We are a Jyvaskyla-based technical and property services company covering HVAC, electrical, building automation and facilities maintenance across Central Finland, and we would welcome the opportunity to support the continued technical management of these properties.
general_sections.company_overview: Visakoivu Oy is a technical and property services company based in Jyvaskyla, serving public and private clients across Central Finland and the surrounding region. Our services span HVAC, electrical, building automation and facilities maintenance, delivered through in-house discipline teams and supported by a track record of outsourcing and framework agreements for both public and private property portfolios.
